candidates.source_name: Asseco Central Europe — Referencie (customer references)
candidates.why_relevant: ACE is the dominant local core-banking / building-savings / omnichannel vendor for SK banks; its own reference page names bank customers, which is often the only public record of a private bank's core system supplier.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: periodic HTML crawl of /referencie/ and /en/ mirror; diff customer list over time
queries_used: Asseco Central Europe referencie banka Slovensko core banking

candidates.source_name: Asseco Central Europe — Správy / press releases (SK newsroom)
candidates.why_relevant: Vendor press releases announce SK bank wins and go-lives (e.g. 30-years-partner-of-banks piece referencing Poštová banka, 365.bank, Slovenská sporiteľňa card processing).
candidates.suggested_collection_method: scheduled listing crawl + article extraction; watch for bank names in body text
queries_used: Asseco Central Europe referencie banka Slovensko core banking

candidates.source_name: Asseco Central Europe — Výročné správy (annual reports, PDF archive)
candidates.why_relevant: Annual reports carry segment revenue by banking/finance vertical, named large contracts and backlog commentary — the closest thing to disclosed spend by private SK banks on core systems.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: PDF download + text extraction, yearly; index bank-name mentions
queries_used: Asseco Central Europe výročná správa 2025 banková divízia zákazníci Slovensko

candidates.source_name: Registeruz.sk — statutory financial statements & annual reports of vendor legal entities (e.g. Asseco Central Europe a.s., IČO 35760419)
candidates.why_relevant: Slovak register of financial statements holds filed accounts/annual reports for every SK-registered vendor subsidiary (Asseco CE, Printec Slovakia, Diebold Nixdorf s.r.o., NCR/Atleos entities), enabling revenue sizing of SK banking-tech spend where vendor group reports do not break out SK.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: lookup by IČO; download PDF/XML statements yearly
queries_used: Asseco Central Europe výročná správa 2025 banková divízia zákazníci Slovensko

candidates.source_name: FinStat.sk — vendor company profiles (revenue, filings, ownership)
candidates.why_relevant: Aggregator over SK registers; fastest way to size and track SK subsidiaries of banking-tech vendors and to find their legal names/IČO for register lookups.
candidates.legal_status: commercial aggregator ToS — check before bulk scraping
candidates.suggested_collection_method: manual/API lookup per vendor entity; avoid bulk scraping
queries_used: Asseco Central Europe výročná správa 2025 banková divízia zákazníci Slovensko

candidates.source_name: Printec Slovakia — country site (ATM/POS/self-service portfolio and market position)
candidates.why_relevant: Printec is a principal SK channel for NCR ATMs and payment terminals; country page and its news items indicate portfolio moves and, occasionally, named SK bank/retail deployments. Peer-benchmark source.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: crawl country page + group newsroom filtered for Slovakia/Slovak bank names
queries_used: dodávateľ bankomatov Slovensko banka zmluva referencia Printec NCR

candidates.source_name: Diebold Nixdorf Investor Relations — press releases
candidates.why_relevant: Global ATM/branch-automation vendor; contract wins and managed-services deals (incl. CEE) are announced here and repeated on earnings calls. No SK-specific release surfaced in this pass, but the feed is the canonical place one would appear.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: poll IR press-release listing + transcripts; keyword filter Slovakia/Slovak/Bratislava/SK bank names
queries_used: Diebold Nixdorf Slovakia bank ATM contract press release

candidates.source_name: NCR Atleos newsroom
candidates.why_relevant: Atleos (ATM hardware/ATMaaS, being acquired by Brink's) announces European branch/ATM-as-a-service wins; SK deployments usually reach the market via partners like Printec, so vendor news plus partner news is the only public trail.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: RSS/listing crawl with SK keyword filter; track Brink's acquisition disclosure stream too
queries_used: "NCR Atleos" OR "Euronet" Slovakia ATM outsourcing bank agreement press release

candidates.source_name: Euronet Worldwide IR newsroom — SK ATM outsourcing announcements
candidates.why_relevant: Euronet has publicly announced SK bank ATM outsourcing (Tatra banka, ~120 ATMs) — a concrete precedent that private SK bank estate deals do get disclosed in vendor IR feeds; also relevant for independent ATM deployment in SK.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: crawl full press-release archive once (historic SK deals), then incremental polling
queries_used: "NCR Atleos" OR "Euronet" Slovakia ATM outsourcing bank agreement press release

candidates.source_name: Temenos — customer/region pages and press (Europe, CEE)
candidates.why_relevant: Temenos publicly names SK-relevant wins: Tatra banka selecting Temenos Multifonds for fund administration (Tatra Asset Management, DDS TB) and Temenos Core live across RBI subsidiaries incl. Slovakia.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: crawl region/sector/customer-story listings + Temenos press feed; cross-check with trade press
queries_used: Temenos OR Ingenico OR Thales OR "Worldline" Slovak bank customer announcement Slovakia

candidates.source_name: Orion Innovation — Temenos partner/licensing announcements covering Slovakia
candidates.why_relevant: System-integrator press releases reveal which markets (explicitly Slovakia) a core-banking stack is being pushed into and who the implementation partner would be — an early indicator of pipeline before any bank announces.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: keyword alerts on SI newsrooms for 'Slovakia'/'Slovak'
queries_used: Temenos OR Ingenico OR Thales OR "Worldline" Slovak bank customer announcement Slovakia

candidates.source_name: SOFTEC s.r.o. — banking references (Tatra banka, Slovenská sporiteľňa, VÚB, ex-Sberbank SK)
candidates.why_relevant: Local SI whose public references name the largest SK banks and describe digital-onboarding/digital-banking work — direct evidence of private bank IT programmes with no public tender record.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: crawl referencie/case-study pages; supplement with company LinkedIn posts
queries_used: Softec OR Datalan OR Gratex OR Anasoft referencie banka Slovensko bankový systém prípadová štúdia

candidates.source_name: ANASOFT — Referencie
candidates.why_relevant: SK software house listing financial-sector references incl. digital transformation of banking processes; useful for mapping which niche systems SK banks buy locally.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: periodic page crawl, diff reference list
queries_used: Softec OR Datalan OR Gratex OR Anasoft referencie banka Slovensko bankový systém prípadová štúdia

candidates.source_name: DATALAN — Referencie (financial sector)
candidates.why_relevant: SK infrastructure/IT integrator with a 'Financie' reference vertical; useful for branch IT, self-service and infrastructure deals at SK banks.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: crawl reference listing filtered to 'Financie'
queries_used: Softec OR Datalan OR Gratex OR Anasoft referencie banka Slovensko bankový systém prípadová štúdia

candidates.source_name: Centrálny register zmlúv (CRZ) — contracts of state-linked banks/institutions with IT and ATM/POS vendors
candidates.why_relevant: Although private banks are out of scope for CRZ, state bodies, NBS-adjacent entities and state-owned banks publish full contract texts naming banking-tech vendors, prices and terms — a price/benchmark anchor for vendor deals otherwise invisible.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: keyword search by vendor name (Asseco, Printec, Diebold, NCR, Softec) + PDF text extraction
queries_used: dodávateľ bankomatov Slovensko banka zmluva referencia Printec NCR

candidates.source_name: Národná banka Slovenska — Zmluvy, objednávky, faktúry (procurement disclosures)
candidates.why_relevant: Central bank publishes contracts, orders and invoices naming IT/cash-handling/card vendors; reveals vendor presence and pricing in the SK market and identifies vendor legal entities to track.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: scheduled scrape of contracts/orders tables; vendor-name matching
queries_used: dodávateľ bankomatov Slovensko banka zmluva referencia Printec NCR

candidates.source_name: ATM Marketplace — vendor company news hubs (Diebold Nixdorf, NCR Atleos)
candidates.why_relevant: Trade-press aggregator of ATM/self-service vendor announcements; efficient single funnel for spotting CEE/SK contract news that vendors publish only regionally.

candidates.suggested_collection_method: RSS/company-hub polling with SK keyword filter; store links+metadata only
queries_used: Diebold Nixdorf Slovakia bank ATM contract press release

candidates.source_name: PR Newswire — vendor contract announcements (Diebold Nixdorf and payment vendors)
candidates.why_relevant: Primary wire where ATM/payment vendors publish contract wins, including multilingual regional versions; searchable archive is a reliable net for any future SK bank win.

queries_used: Diebold Nixdorf Slovakia bank ATM contract press release

candidates.why_relevant: Terminal and acquiring-side vendor news; Worldline/Ingenico consolidation reshapes SK POS estates, and merchant-acquiring or bank terminal deals are announced here rather than in any SK public record.

candidates.source_name: Slovenská banková asociácia (ZBK) — card and payments articles
candidates.why_relevant: Banking association content on card issuance/personalisation practice occasionally names technology and card-production practices across member banks; a pointer into which banks run which card programmes.

candidates.why_relevant: SK-language tech press reports vendor product launches with SK banks (e.g. IDEMIA Touch Card coverage); often the only SK-language echo of a vendor announcement.

negative_findings.description: No Diebold Nixdorf press release naming a Slovak bank contract was found in this pass (searched EN vendor IR feed, PR Newswire and ATM Marketplace hubs).
negative_findings.result_summary: Only non-SK deals surfaced (Geldmaat NL, FOREX Nordics, awards releases). Absence is unconfirmed — the IR archive was not exhaustively paged.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Diebold Nixdorf is a plausible incumbent in SK branch automation; if it never announces SK wins, the indirect route for that vendor is weak and other proxies (register filings, CRZ, job ads) must carry the load.

negative_findings.description: No card-personalisation bureau serving Slovak banks was publicly identified (Thales/Gemalto, IDEMIA, Giesecke+Devrient country pages did not surface with SK bank customer names).
negative_findings.result_summary: SK-language search on 'personalizácia kariet' / 'výroba platobných kariet' returned consumer-facing bank pages and glossaries, not supplier disclosures.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Card personalisation is a recurring, contracted spend; without a named bureau, this sub-segment of the cell has no source coverage at all.

negative_findings.description: Slovak-language terminology for vendor case studies is thin: 'prípadová štúdia' is rarely used by SK IT vendors, who publish 'referencie' lists without narrative detail, and many vendor sites publish only EN case studies.
negative_findings.result_summary: SK searches returned reference index pages rather than detailed, dated deal descriptions.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection design must expect low-signal reference lists and rely on diffing lists over time plus EN-language vendor case studies for narrative.

negative_findings.description: Several candidate URLs (Softec, Ingenico newsroom, NCR Atleos news index, ce.asseco.com annual report PDF) were identified via search results rather than fetched in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: URLs recorded with confidence scores; liveness left to the deterministic verification pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Prevents recording bot-defended or moved pages as dead sources.

coverage_gaps.description: No coverage yet of payment-processing / card-issuing-platform vendors serving SK banks (e.g. OpenWay, BPC/SmartVista, Tieto/TietoEVRY Card Suite, Comtrade, Monet+, Trask, Sofort/Nexi-type processors).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run targeted vendor-by-vendor searches pairing each platform name with SK bank names and with 'Slovensko'; check TietoEVRY and BPC customer pages, which historically list CEE issuers.

coverage_gaps.description: Vendor earnings-call transcripts and investor decks were not mined; SK wins are often mentioned verbally rather than in press releases.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add transcript sources (vendor IR webcast pages, SEC filings for Diebold Nixdorf/Brink's-Atleos/Euronet/Worldline) and keyword-search transcripts for 'Slovak'.

coverage_gaps.description: Vendor and bank hiring/partner signals (LinkedIn posts, job ads naming core systems, partner directories) not yet catalogued as indirect sources.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add SK job boards (profesia.sk) and LinkedIn company pages as indirect sources; search job ads for system names (e.g. 'eStarBANK', 'Temenos', 'SmartVista') to infer bank-vendor pairings.

coverage_gaps.description: Smaller SK banks and branches of foreign banks (Prima banka, Tatra banka's RBI stack, 365.bank, ČSOB, mBank SK, Fio, Slovenská záručná a rozvojová banka) not yet mapped to named vendors.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build a bank-by-vendor matrix and search each bank name against each major vendor domain (site: queries) in both SK and EN.

brief: For Slovakia, vendor-side disclosure is a genuinely productive indirect route into private-bank procurement: Asseco Central Europe (SK newsroom, referencie page, SK/EN annual reports) openly names Poštová banka, 365.bank and Slovenská sporiteľňa work, Temenos publicly ties Tatra banka and the RBI stack to its platforms, and Euronet's IR archive documents Tatra banka ATM outsourcing. Global ATM vendors (Diebold Nixdorf, NCR Atleos) surfaced no SK-specific release in this pass, so their SK footprint is best tracked indirectly through Printec as channel partner, trade press (ATM Marketplace, PR Newswire) and SK statutory filings of their local entities via registeruz.sk/FinStat. Public registers (CRZ, NBS procurement disclosures) provide vendor-name and price anchors even though private banks do not file there. Main gaps: card-personalisation bureaus serving SK banks are entirely unidentified, card-issuing platform vendors are unmapped, and earnings-call transcripts have not yet been mined for SK mentions.
